content_sections.heading: ESIC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ESIC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ESIC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 18 vacancies are available - 1 for Specialist - General Medicine, 1 for Specialist - Obstetrics & Gynaecology, 1 for Specialist - Ophthalmology, 1 for Specialist - Pulmonology, 1 for Specialist - Microbiology, 1 for Specialist - Psychiatry, 1 for Specialist - Paediatrics, 2 for Senior Resident - General Medicine, 3 for Senior Resident - Obstetrics & Gynaecology, 2 for Senior Resident - Anaesthesia, 1 for Senior Resident - Biochemistry, 1 for Senior Resident - Radiology, and 2 for Senior Resident - ICU.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Specialist (General Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Ophthalmology, Pulmonology, Microbiology, Psychiatry, Paediatrics): MBBS with TCMC registration and PG Degree/DNB or Diploma in the concerned speciality. Senior Resident (General Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Anaesthesia, Biochemistry, Radiology): MBBS with TCMC registration and PG Degree/DNB or Diploma in the concerned speciality. Senior Resident (ICU): MBBS with TCMC registration and PG Degree/DNB or Diploma in Anaesthesia/General Medicine/Pulmonology/Critical Care.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 69 years for all posts. Age relaxation for reserved candidates as per rules for Senior Residents. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ESIC Specialist and Senior Resident posts is scheduled for 25 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by ESIC Ezhukone?
faq.answer: ESIC Ezhukone has announced a total of 18 vacancies for the posts of Specialist and Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for the ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 69 years. There is no minimum age limit specified for these positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Specialist and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with TCMC registration and a PG Degree/DNB or Diploma in the concerned speciality. Specific qualifications may vary for certain Senior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Specialist and Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 142,514/- per month, depending on the post and experience.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the ESIC Ezhukone recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report to the ESIC office on the specified date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 250/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 50/- for SC/ST candidates. PwBD and Women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Employees State Insurance Corporation Hospital Ezhukone, Kollam, Kerala.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is applicable for reserved category candidates as per government rules, specifically mentioned for Senior Resident posts.
